# MDN Web Docs

> > MDN Web Docs is Mozilla's comprehensive resource for web developers, providing documentation, tutorials, and references for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web APIs, and modern web development practices.

MDN (Mozilla Developer Network) serves as the authoritative documentation platform for web standards and technologies, featuring extensive API references, learning resources, and community-driven content. The site includes the MDN Curriculum for structured front-end development education, regular blog updates on web platform features like Baseline compatibility indicators, and active engagement through GitHub and Discord communities.

## Key Topics

- Web APIs
- CSS
- HTML
- JavaScript
- Baseline compatibility
- Web components
- MDN Curriculum
- Frontend development
- Web standards
- Modern CSS
- Platform architecture
- Mozilla
- GitHub
- Community contributions

## MDN Platform & Community

- [Lift-off: The MDN Curriculum launch](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/blog/mdn-curriculum-launch): Launch announcement of MDN Curriculum for front-end development training
- [Launching MDN's new front end](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/blog/launching-new-front-end): MDN's UI redesign with modern CSS, web components, and Baseline support
- [Welcome to the MDN blog](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/blog/welcome-to-the-MDN-blog): Announcement of MDN blog launch for web development news and tutorials
